title: War of the Remences
summary:
The English Wikipedia article "War of the Remences", at revision 1381364377, opens: "The Rebellion of the Remences or War of the Remences was a popular revolt in late medieval Europe against seignorial pressures that began in the Principality of Catalonia in 1462 and ended a decade later without definitive result.
Ferdinand II of Aragon finally resolved the conflict with the Sentencia Arbitral de Guadalupe in 1486." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1956078, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Two 15th century peasant revolts in Catalonia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
